chapters.title: Still Us
chapters.synopsis: They are together and still themselves. The Bell is ahead. The sling is not a personality.

chapters.title: Her Brother
chapters.synopsis: Leona parleys. She will help stop Cho if a record survives that cannot teach anyone how to ask.

chapters.title: The Listening Court
chapters.synopsis: Priya walks the murals, gives a few of the Unfinished their names back, and decides to break the weapon stanza.

chapters.title: Lantern
chapters.synopsis: Pavel's warning is still broadcasting because the Marrow finishes patterns, including transmissions. The rapids story dies.

chapters.title: The Mouth
chapters.synopsis: Ivo understands the Bell and feels the shape of a cure he does not ask for. Calder does not grab his wrist.

chapters.title: Cho
chapters.synopsis: Helix reaches the striker. Aegis fights with one good arm, a beta who knows animals, and eels that hate metal.

chapters.title: Half
chapters.synopsis: Cho is half-answered. The resonance is flooded, the wheel broken, Harun pinned, and the cure left in the dark.

chapters.title: The Record
chapters.synopsis: They come out of the green. Ivo does not forget. He chooses Calder anyway.

chapters.title: One Note Higher
chapters.synopsis: Six months later the team is alive and altered. A listening post hears the Vein change pitch. Not tonight, Ivo says.
